packaging/appimage/media.json.purpose: Screen recording runtime inside the AppImage: putgd-record's GStreamer capture plugins and its private FFmpeg export libraries (docs/recording.md, packaging/appimage/README.md). Host GPU encoders come first; the bundled x264/x265 are the fallback. The demuxers and decoders beyond the working clip's Matroska/H.264/AAC, and the MJPEG and PCM encoders, serve only the lab diagnostics (--motion, --preview, --av-marker, --av-sync) on exported MP4, WebM and GIF copies. The image is a GPL-2.0-or-later combined work; its corresponding source is the release's appimage-complete-source asset (tools/releases/appimage_complete_sources.py).

provenance.evidence: Runtime strings identify squashfuse 0.5.2, zstd 1.5.6, zlib 1.3.1 and fuse 3.15.0. Matched debug DWARF identifies musl 1.2.5. mi_version at address 0x63340 returns 0xd9 (217 = mimalloc 2.1.7). Runtime build scripts pin fuse/squashfuse with SHA-256 and include the libfuse patch. Alpine 3.21 recipes below are the latest matching recipes before the asset build, including distro patches. Upstream build logs expired (HTTP 410); no byte-identical rebuild claim.

protonSource.distributionRequirement: Retain public availability of this current corresponding-source transport and deliver the current application source and catalog beside installers. Earlier SDK/Crypto/Bun transports remain historical.
